scope: Read-only review prompted by the intermediate decoder rejection; no new optimization or causal proof

findings.observation: With gpu_plaintext_fft enabled, prefetch producers construct public masks but skip encode_cpu; GPU encoding and cache lookup remain on the evaluator thread
The assignment/consumption window, ring slots and cancellation are guarded by one mutex; consumption stays ordered
Cached entry eligibility is checked by level, width and complete coefficient-bit equality after hashing; cache index is opt-in
Temporary arithmetic detaches aliased operands before mutation and synchronizes before releasing the right operand

limitation: This inspection cannot exclude backend state corruption, undefined behavior, numerical range issues or stochastic decryption/bootstrapping effects. No race or cache corruption is demonstrated.
